title: Supported dimensions
content_data:
A dimension is an attribute to group your data by. Playable ad reports support the following dimensions. Please note that currently, we don't support all dimensions available on TikTok Ads Manager. # Supported dimensions ``` xtable | Dimension Name{20%} | Description {80%}| | --- | --- | | playable_id| Group by playable ID.| | country_code| Group by location code. For enum values, see [Appendix-Location IDs](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739311040498689).
Note that `country_code` only works for playable synchronous reports.
See [Supported metrics for a dimension in playable ad reports](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762405483224065) to learn about the supported metrics for this dimension.| ``` # Dimension grouping - playable_id - playable_id + country_code

seo_description: Learn more about the dimensions that you can use in playable ad reports to group your data by. Get a clear and concise explanation of the dimensions.
